description: This file declares the X509Certificate class and related enums and functions for handling X.509 certificates, including creation, parsing, validation, and encoding.

classes.name: X509Certificate
classes.description: Represents an X.509 certificate, providing methods for creation, validation, and encoding, including handling of certificate chains and subject/issuer details.

methods.name: CreateFromBuffer
methods.description: Creates an X509Certificate object from a DER-encoded buffer and intermediates.

methods.name: CreateFromDERCertChain
methods.description: Creates an X509Certificate object from a chain of DER-encoded certificates.

methods.name: CreateFromBytes
methods.description: Creates an X509Certificate object from raw byte data.

methods.name: CreateFromPickle
methods.description: Creates an X509Certificate object from a serialized pickle.

methods.name: CreateCertificateListFromBytes
methods.description: Parses multiple certificates from byte data based on specified format.

methods.name: GetPEMEncodedFromDER
methods.description: Converts DER-encoded certificate data to PEM format.

methods.name: GetPEMEncoded
methods.description: Converts a CRYPTO_BUFFER containing a certificate to PEM format.

methods.name: CalculateFingerprint256
methods.description: Computes the SHA-256 fingerprint of a certificate buffer.

methods.name: CalculateChainFingerprint256
methods.description: Computes the SHA-256 fingerprint of the entire certificate chain.

methods.name: IsSelfSigned
methods.description: Checks if a certificate buffer is self-signed.
